title: Kaamannana Makkalu
desc: With the help of his two sons, Kaamanna, a former thief, decides to start a new life on the right side of the law.

title: Sye
desc: Chakri, who dreams to become a police officer, falls for a woman named Kannika. But things change when Mosale, a corrupt policeman, provokes him to fight.

title: Vaalee
desc: A man with a hearing and speech impairment secretly loves his twin brother's wife. He tries his best to separate the two, to the extent of following them on their honeymoon.

title: Dhumm
desc: When Varada learns that his rival has killed his sister, he decides to avenge her death. He goes against the wishes of his mother who does not support his reckless methods.

title: Just Math Mathalli
desc: In a desperate attempt to reconcile with Tanu, the girl he had previously rejected, popular singer Siddharth flies to Singapore. On the flight, he meets Adi, a scriptwriter, and shares his love story.
